body:
Oracle said on Friday that its infrastructure contract with OpenAI is fully funded after a final capital raise earlier this month, Reuters reported, answering investor questions about how much money the company needs for its AI data center expansion and how exposed it is to a single customer [[1]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-infrastructure-deal-is-fully-funded-after-final-capital-raise-5042771). "The financing we outlined at Oracle Investor Day, including vendor financing, is in place," Oracle said in a post on X, adding that further private discussions with vendors are "just additional options" [[1]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-infrastructure-deal-is-fully-funded-after-final-capital-raise-5042771).

At its Oct. 28 investor day, Oracle committed to limit new capital-markets funding for its fiscal 2027 to 2030 investment cycle to $20 billion, split between $10 billion of equity and $10 billion of gross debt and excluding refinancing [[3]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526435853/d75538dex991.htm). That came on top of a $20 billion at-the-market equity raise completed in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 [[3]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526435853/d75538dex991.htm). The company said vendor financing, customer-provided hardware and customer prepayments would reduce its upfront cash needs until free cash flow turns positive [[3]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526435853/d75538dex991.htm).

Oracle used the whole $20 billion allowance within a week. On Nov. 2 it agreed to sell 86,206,897 shares at $116 each, about $10 billion, and $10 billion of notes due between 2029 and 2046 with coupons from 7% to 8.65%; both offerings closed on Nov. 4, according to its filings [[4]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526447507/d131790d8k.htm)[[5]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526445846/d181336d424b2.htm).

OpenAI's computing agreement with Oracle has been reported as a five-year, $300 billion contract, and the companies plan 4.5 gigawatts of additional US data center capacity beyond the first Stargate site in Abilene, Texas [[1]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-infrastructure-deal-is-fully-funded-after-final-capital-raise-5042771)[[2]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-contract-is-fully-funded-addresses-market-financing-scrutiny-5042772). Oracle's leverage and its reliance on one customer have drawn scrutiny as investors question circular financing and off-balance-sheet arrangements across the AI buildout [[2]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-contract-is-fully-funded-addresses-market-financing-scrutiny-5042772). Lenders have been pulling back from AI debt, and the WSJ reported this week that Wall Street had not put up any of the $500 billion it pledged for Nvidia customers (see our coverage of AI debt and the WSJ report).

Oracle said the Abilene campus, where OpenAI trained its latest model, is nearly complete, its next gigawatt-scale campus in Shackelford County, Texas, is fully permitted, and handover of Nvidia Vera Rubin racks is on track for the coming weeks [[1]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-infrastructure-deal-is-fully-funded-after-final-capital-raise-5042771). It reiterated that it expects positive free cash flow in the second half of fiscal 2028 and more than $30 billion of free cash flow in fiscal 2029 [[2]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-contract-is-fully-funded-addresses-market-financing-scrutiny-5042772)[[3]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526435853/d75538dex991.htm).

p: Oracle은 금요일, 이달 초 마지막 자금조달을 마쳐 OpenAI와의 인프라 계약이 전액 자금 확보를 마쳤다고 밝혔다고 Reuters가 보도했다. 이는 AI 데이터센터 확장에 얼마나 많은 자금이 필요한지, 단일 고객에 얼마나 노출돼 있는지를 둘러싼 투자자들의 의문에 답한 것이다 [[1]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-infrastructure-deal-is-fully-funded-after-final-capital-raise-5042771). Oracle은 X(옛 트위터) 게시글에서 "벤더 파이낸싱을 포함해 Oracle Investor Day에서 설명한 자금조달은 모두 마련됐다"며, 벤더들과 비공개로 진행 중인 추가 논의는 "추가적인 옵션일 뿐"이라고 덧붙였다 [[1]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-infrastructure-deal-is-fully-funded-after-final-capital-raise-5042771).

Oracle은 10월 28일 열린 투자자의 날(investor day)에서 2027~2030 회계연도 투자 사이클의 신규 자본시장 조달을 200억 달러로 제한하겠다고 공약했다. 내역은 지분 100억 달러와 총 부채 100억 달러이며, 리파이낸싱은 제외된다 [[3]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526435853/d75538dex991.htm). 이는 2027 회계연도 1분기에 완료한 200억 달러 규모의 ATM(at-the-market) 방식 지분 조달에 더해진 것이다 [[3]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526435853/d75538dex991.htm). Oracle은 벤더 파이낸싱, 고객 제공 하드웨어, 고객 선급금이 잉여현금흐름이 플러스로 전환될 때까지 초기 현금 소요를 줄여줄 것이라고 밝혔다 [[3]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526435853/d75538dex991.htm).

Oracle은 200억 달러 한도를 일주일 만에 모두 소진했다. 11월 2일 주당 116달러에 8,620만 6,897주, 약 100억 달러어치를 매각하기로 합의했고, 쿠폰 7%~8.65%, 만기 2029~2046년의 채권 100억 달러어치도 발행하기로 했다. 공시에 따르면 두 건의 발행은 모두 11월 4일 마무리됐다 [[4]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526447507/d131790d8k.htm)[[5]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526445846/d181336d424b2.htm).

OpenAI와 Oracle의 컴퓨팅 계약은 5년간 3,000억 달러 규모로 보도돼 왔으며, 양사는 텍사스주 애빌린의 첫 Stargate 부지 외에 미국 내 데이터센터 용량 4.5기가와트를 추가로 구축할 계획이다 [[1]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-infrastructure-deal-is-fully-funded-after-final-capital-raise-5042771)[[2]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-contract-is-fully-funded-addresses-market-financing-scrutiny-5042772). 투자자들이 AI 인프라 구축 전반의 순환 금융(circular financing)과 부외 거래를 의문시하는 가운데, Oracle의 레버리지와 단일 고객 의존도도 도마에 올랐다 [[2]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-contract-is-fully-funded-addresses-market-financing-scrutiny-5042772). 대주단은 AI 관련 부채에서 발을 빼고 있으며, WSJ는 이번 주 월가가 Nvidia 고객용으로 약속한 5,000억 달러 가운데 한 푼도 내놓지 않았다고 보도했다(AI 부채 및 WSJ 보도에 관한 당사 기사 참조).

Oracle은 OpenAI가 최신 모델을 학습시킨 애빌린 캠퍼스가 거의 완공됐고, 텍사스주 섀클퍼드 카운티에 들어설 다음 기가와트급 캠퍼스는 인허가를 모두 마쳤으며, Nvidia Vera Rubin 랙 인도도 앞으로 몇 주 안에 이뤄질 예정이라고 밝혔다 [[1]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-infrastructure-deal-is-fully-funded-after-final-capital-raise-5042771). 또한 2028 회계연도 하반기에 잉여현금흐름이 플러스로 돌아서고, 2029 회계연도에는 잉여현금흐름이 300억 달러를 넘을 것이라는 기존 전망을 재확인했다 [[2]](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oracle-says-openai-contract-is-fully-funded-addresses-market-financing-scrutiny-5042772)[[3]](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526435853/d75538dex991.htm).
중요한 이야기만 모아 이메일 하나로. 무료이며 언제든 구독 해지할 수 있습니다.
전체 리서치와 분석, 10년 이상의 재무 데이터, 13F 보유 현황 및 AI 인프라 데이터를 제공하며, 팔로우하는 기업의 공시 알림도 받아볼 수 있습니다.
